parts.covers: Checks the stated line_amount = qty * unit_price premise on June till lines; this arithmetic identity alone cannot establish whether unit_price was discounted, so the second plan compares it with the product list price.
parts.sql: select count(*) as "june_lines", sum(("pos-lines-may-june"."line_amount" - ("pos-lines-may-june"."qty" * "pos-lines-may-june"."unit_price"))) as "lines_not_qty_times_price" from "pos-lines-may-june"  where (substr("pos-lines-may-june"."bill_ts",1,10) >= ?) and (substr("pos-lines-may-june"."bill_ts",1,10) < ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From till line records; keep rows where pos lines may.bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' and pos lines may.bill_ts < '2026-07-01'; report june_lines = count of *, lines_not_qty_times_price = sum of pos lines may.line_amount - pos lines may.qty * pos lines may.unit_price.

parts.covers: Finds June lines for the eleven followed items whose unit price is below products.price_inr, using a below-list charged price as the recorded evidence of a discount; no rows means no such discount is recorded.
parts.sql: select "pos-lines-may-june"."sku_scanned" as "sku", "products"."name" as "product", "products"."price_inr" as "list_price_inr", "pos-lines-may-june"."unit_price" as "charged_unit_price_inr", count(*) as "lines_below_list", sum("pos-lines-may-june"."qty") as "units_below_list", min("pos-lines-may-june"."bill_ts") as "first_seen", max("pos-lines-may-june"."bill_ts") as "last_seen" from "pos-lines-may-june" inner join "products" on "pos-lines-may-june"."sku_scanned" = "products"."sku" where (substr("pos-lines-may-june"."bill_ts",1,10) >= ?) and (substr("pos-lines-may-june"."bill_ts",1,10) < ?) and ("pos-lines-may-june"."unit_price" < "products"."price_inr") group by "pos-lines-may-june"."sku_scanned", "products"."name", "products"."price_inr", "pos-lines-may-june"."unit_price" order by "sku" asc, "charged_unit_price_inr" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From till line records; inner-join product records on pos lines may.sku_scanned = products.sku; keep rows where pos lines may.bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' and pos lines may.bill_ts < '2026-07-01' and pos lines may.unit_price < products.price_inr; group by pos lines may.sku_scanned, products.name, products.price_inr, pos lines may.unit_price; report sku = pos lines may.sku_scanned, product = products.name, list_price_inr = products.price_inr, charged_unit_price_inr = pos lines may.unit_price, lines_below_list = count of *, units_below_list = sum of pos lines may.qty, first_seen = min of pos lines may.bill_ts, last_seen = max of pos lines may.bill_ts; sorted by sku asc, charged_unit_price_inr asc.

parts.covers: Checks the 30-versus-28 premise using approved June payments: the first and last billing dates and how many distinct dates have bills; actual opening days and any open day with no recorded payment are not recorded.

parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; keep rows where shelf audits.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and shelf audits.status = 'empty' and day(shelf audits.audit_ts) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30; report empty_audits = count of *, first_empty_audit = min of shelf audits.audit_ts, last_empty_audit = max of shelf audits.audit_ts.

parts.covers: Recorded June daily sales of 5 kg atta, including zero-sale days, as evidence for a labelled lost-sale estimate; actual demand and shoppers who did not buy are not recorded.
parts.sql: select "daily-sales-june"."date" as "date", sum("daily-sales-june"."units_sold") as "units_sold" from "daily-sales-june"  where ("daily-sales-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) group by "daily-sales-june"."date" order by "date" asc limit 30
parts.plan_in_words: From daily sales row records; keep rows where daily sales.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(daily sales.date) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30; group by daily sales.date; report date = daily sales.date, units_sold = sum of daily sales.units_sold; sorted by date asc.

parts.covers: The 28-day-mean sales forecast is a labelled stand-in for June demand for 5 kg atta; true demand, lost sales and the number of shoppers are not recorded, and one unit need not equal one shopper.
parts.sql: select sum("forecasts-june"."forecast_units_per_day") as "forecast_units_june", avg("forecasts-june"."forecast_units_per_day") as "avg_daily_forecast_units", count(*) as "forecast_days" from "forecasts-june"  where ("forecasts-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("forecasts-june"."date",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From forecast row records; keep rows where forecasts.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(forecasts.date) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30; report forecast_units_june = sum of forecasts.forecast_units_per_day, avg_daily_forecast_units = avg of forecasts.forecast_units_per_day, forecast_days = count of *.

parts.covers: June approved bills are a labelled stand-in for shopper traffic; no customer identity exists, a bill is not necessarily one shopper, and shoppers who left without 5 kg atta are not recorded.
parts.sql: select count(distinct "pos-payments-june"."bill_id") as "june_bills" from "pos-payments-june"  where ("pos-payments-june"."till_status" = ?) and (substr(substr("pos-payments-june"."ts",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From payment attempt records; keep rows where pos payments.till_status = 'approved' and day(pos payments.ts) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30; report june_bills = count distinct of pos payments.bill_id.

parts.covers: Shows which candidate extra debits already have a recorded completed refund so the plan does not treat them as still unpaid; bank-side receipt is not recorded.

parts.plan_in_words: From UPI refund records; inner-join UPI service provider's transaction records on upi refunds.rrn = psp upi report.rrn; left-join payment attempt records on upi refunds.rrn = pos payments.rrn; keep rows where psp upi report.status = 'success' and pos payments.rrn is empty; report refund_id = upi refunds.refund_id, rrn = upi refunds.rrn, bill_id = upi refunds.bill_id, amount_inr = upi refunds.amount_inr, completed_ts = upi refunds.completed_ts; sorted by completed_ts asc.
